Featured Case Study: Kampala International University

Challenge

When the COVID-19 pandemic hit, Kampala International University needed to rapidly transition 200+ faculty members to online teaching with minimal disruption to student learning.

Solution

I developed a comprehensive faculty training program that included:

  • Interactive Articulate Storyline modules on online teaching best practices
  • Hands-on Moodle workshops for course setup and management
  • Video production training using Camtasia
  • Templates and guidelines for consistent course design

Outcome

Within 3 weeks, 95% of faculty successfully transitioned their courses online. Student satisfaction ratings remained above 85%, and the university has since adopted a permanent blended learning approach.
